Blue Star Auto Salon

Dunn’s Auto Detail Salon

Tips Before Booking:

Ask about the paint condition: Depending on how deep your scratches or swirl marks are, ask if your car needs a 1-step polish (great for light gloss enhancement and minor swirls) or a multi-step correction (heavy cutting compound followed by a refining polish for deeper defects).

Consider protection: Paint correction strips away microscopic layers of clear coat to level the surface. Most shops heavily recommend locking in that freshly corrected finish with a ceramic coating or a high-grade sealant right after so it stays protected.
